answer: We define a mechanism where agents commit dynamic opportunity-cost bonds to a trellis of zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions that scale slashing penalties quadratically with identity volume. This subgame-perfect punishment matrix forces the expected payoff of Sybil multiplication to be negative, as the tide of staked capital required to overwhelm the network exceeds the lotus of projected protocol rewards.
